_meanings:
.²1 Conquest, victory.
.²2 A kind of military array.
.²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the charioteer of king Dhṛtarāṣṭra. He tried to bring about
 a peaceful settlement of the dispute between the Kauravas and Pāṇḍavas,
 but failed. It was he who narrated the events of the great Bhāratī war
 to the blind king Dhṛtarāṣṭra; <ab>cf.</ab> {#Darmakzetre kurukzetre samavetA#}
